face.name: Volcanic Potion
face.text: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
face.flavorText: The secret ingredient in Kazakus's award-winning chili recipe.

face.name: 冰霜新星
face.text: 冻结所有敌方随从。
face.flavorText: 嘿，伙计，这会冻死你的。我是说真的。

face.name: Frost Nova
face.text: Freeze all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: Hey man, that's cold. Literally and metaphorically.

face.name: 冰枪术
face.text: 冻结一个角色，如果该角色已被冻结，则改为对其造成 4点伤害。
face.flavorText: 这个把戏的重点是别把冰枪弄断。否则，“冰渣术”可就没这么厉害了。

face.name: Ice Lance
face.text: Freeze a character. If it was already Frozen, deal 4 damage instead.
face.flavorText: The trick is not to break the lance. Otherwise, you have "Ice Pieces." Ice Pieces aren't as effective.

face.name: 冰刺
face.text: 对一个随从造成 2点伤害。如果它已被冻结，抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 这个法术听起来很次，实际上并非如此。

face.name: Icicle
face.text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it's Frozen, draw a card.
face.flavorText: This may appear weak at frost glance, but it's actually a very ice spell.

face.name: 烈焰轰击
face.text: 随机对一个敌方随从造成 4点伤害。
face.flavorText: 把某个法术称作为烈焰轰击并不能把它从根本上与其他地精装置的效果区别开来。

face.name: Flamecannon
face.text: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy minion.
face.flavorText: Calling something a flamecannon really doesn't do much to distinguish it from other goblin devices.

face.name: 燃烬风暴
face.text: 造成 5点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 天气预报：火球红色预警信号！请关闭门窗，避免一切户外活动。

face.name: Cinderstorm
face.text: Deal 5 damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: Forecast: "Cloudy with a chance of fireballs."

face.name: 克苏恩面具
face.text: 造成 10点伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 戴上面具，与之共生；巨眼闪烁，真相纷呈。

face.name: Mask of C'Thun
face.text: Deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: Hide in the mask, but it will wear you. Through its gleaming eye, you shall see true.

face.name: 研发计划
face.text: 每个玩家抽两张牌。
face.flavorText: 摘要：本文重点分析了寒光智者在新时代新环境下对牌库数据体系构造的影响及实际应用。 结论：抽两张牌。

face.name: Research Project
face.text: Each player draws 2 cards.
face.flavorText: Abstract: Analyzing systemic applications of coldlight data sets vis-a-vis shuffle-related paradigms. Conclusion: Yay, cards!

face.name: 冰爆
face.text: 消灭一个被冻结的随从。
face.flavorText: 想来杯慕斯冰沙吗？稍等片刻！

face.name: Shatter
face.text: Destroy a Frozen minion.
face.flavorText: What's cooler than being cool?

face.name: 冰爆冲击

face.flavorText: 说句公道话，反正他们也没法解冻了。

face.name: Shattering Blast
face.text: Destroy all Frozen minions.
face.flavorText: Let's be honest, they weren't going to unfreeze anyway.

face.flavorText: 砰！上古之神！

face.name: Yogg in the Box
face.text: Cast 5 random spells. If your deck has no minions, the spells cast cost (5) or more.

face.name: 熔岩镜像

face.flavorText: Dang, I'm looking pretty hot!

uncertainties: Both printed Flame Lance editions retain their original IDs and unit source membership; no unconfirmed generation-family weighting is inferred or global pool edited.
Ice Lance uses initial current frozen state: already frozen deals damage instead of applying another freeze. Shatter/WC_041 use current frozen state and public board eligibility.
Ice Bolt captures the original target frozen condition before its damage, so a lethal packet still owes the draw. Normal packet, death, draw, replacement and burn handling remain shared.
Research Project resolves the caster two draws then opponent two draws under the existing sequential Draw interpreter. Exact simultaneous-death/order CN boundary is uncalibrated.
Current friendly minion copy uses the ordinary attributed CopyMinion material and summon quantity/capacity; no card-layer copying or summon resolver.

Puzzle Box uses the complete ordinary collectible-spell domain across classes for ten casts. Yogg in the Box freezes the initial no-minion-deck branch and five-cast min-cost query; it does not use the past Mage179 or Arcane84 inventory as a substitute.
Existing split-damage bonus-once unit-packet policy and exact CN freeze/damage/death timing remain recorded; version alignment and rule-edge calibration stay deferred.

Flamecannon uses the existing use-rule callback API, minimally enabled for manual spells, requiring at least one living enemy board minion, with shared automatic handling. Dormant-count and exact auto-fizzle edges remain local/unconfirmed. The historical Fireplace implementation is supporting community evidence, not current CN server proof.
